Telangana HC Bars Media Outlets Over Defamatory Content Against Minister's Son

The Telangana High Court has issued an order restraining over 50 media outlets from circulating material deemed defamatory against Bandi Bhageerath, son of a Union Minister. The court's directive specifically addresses content related to a rape case.
